behaviors.description: Describe compound Spanner IAM plus SQL grants.
limitations: Primary FGAC system-role docs establish all fine-grained users implicitly inherit SQL public, and unconditioned databaseRoleUser permits all roles. Returned GoogleSQL table/column GRANT SELECT TO ROLE public now projects count only, joined to exact same-database broad spanner.databases.useRoleBasedAccess observations. Named-role SELECT requires both useRoleBasedAccess and databaseRoles.use in the same unconditioned exact-database grant. This is a configured conjunction, not public-principal grantability, accepted OAuth, role selection or successful read proof. SQL public is not IAM allUsers.

Case-preserving grantee parsing avoids converting Public/PUBLIC into predefined lowercase public. Native table grants support quoted ordinary role identifiers, role lists, mixed SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE privilege order and column lists, and schema-qualified tables. Malformed lexical statements and noncanonical REVOKE schema reject all positive context. Escaped role spelling and PostgreSQL remain unassessed; conditional public IAM role selectors are not evaluated, and parent scopes/project aliases are not expanded. System public cannot inherit other roles; unconditional all-role use requires no named-role membership graph. No raw DDL/identifiers persist and no sessions, SQL queries, data reads or changes occur. https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/reference/standard-sql/data-definition-language#grant_statement and https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/fgac-system-roles
